children: Mexico continues stocking up on U.S. corn, with private exporters reporting a sale of 312,700 metric tons for the 2026/27 marketing year, the USDA says. Mexico also bought 150,000 metric tons of U.S. soybeans. The USDA reported flash sales of more than 2 million tons of corn to Mexico last week, including 594,360 tons for 2027/28, and 110,000 metric tons for 2026/27 on Monday. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
